name: CupertinoTextField
description: An iOS-style text field for inputting text. Supports placeholder text, controllers, focus, and styling options.

properties.name: controller
properties.description: Controls the text being edited. Useful for reading and modifying the text.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Text displayed when the field is empty.

properties.name: onChanged
properties.description: Called when the user changes the text.
properties.possible_values: Any function that takes a String.

properties.name: keyboardType
properties.description: The type of keyboard to use for editing the text.

properties.name: obscureText
properties.description: Whether to hide the text being entered, useful for passwords.

properties.name: prefix
properties.description: An optional widget to display before the text field (like an icon).

properties.name: suffix
properties.description: An optional widget to display after the text field (like a clear button).

properties.name: decoration
properties.description: The decoration around the text field.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.
